title: Prompt Filing of a Ridgeline Tool Rental Damage Dispute
content:
Filing a Ridgeline Tool Rental damage dispute soon after the return lowers the excess the renter keeps on a protected damage repair charge.

**Rule.** A prompt dispute lowers the excess the renter keeps: when the approved dispute was filed within 3 calendar days of the return date, 100.00 dollars are taken off it; when the approved dispute was filed 4 to 7 calendar days after the return date, 50.00 dollars are taken off; when it was filed later, nothing is taken off.

**Counting.** The days run from the date part of the return time on the agreement, as day 0, to the date the approved dispute was registered.

The amount taken off is subtracted from the excess the renter keeps after the renter's share of the excess has been figured, and the excess the renter keeps never goes below zero. No amount on the way is rounded; the adjustment is rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Filing table

| Calendar days from the return date to filing | Taken off the excess kept |
|---|---|
| 0 to 3 | 100.00 |
| 4 to 7 | 50.00 |
| 8 or more | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases (returned 10 August at 16:30)

| Approved dispute registered | Day count | Taken off |
|---|---|---|
| 13 August | 3 | 100.00 |
| 14 August | 4 | 50.00 |
| 17 August | 7 | 50.00 |
| 18 August | 8 | nothing |

With a share of the excess of 60.00 and a filing on day 2, 60.00 less 100.00 would be below zero, so the excess the renter keeps is 0.00.
